The [Coin Flip](/coin-flip) is a free online tool on CalcHub. Flip one or more virtual coins with an even heads-or-tails chance. Enter your number of coins and seed (deterministic — for games/demos only) and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. Because it runs entirely in your browser, the values you type never leave your device, and you can use it as often as you like.

Flip one or more virtual coins with an even heads-or-tails chance. This free online coin flip gives you an instant answer without an account, a download or sending your entries to a server. It is designed for quick everyday use on desktop and mobile. This guide explains how to use it, the formula it applies, and a worked example you can follow with your own numbers.

## How to use the Coin Flip

Start by entering your number of coins, then entering your seed (deterministic — for games/demos only). The result updates as you type, so adjust any value and watch the answer change. If the answer is not what you expected, check the value you entered first — a missing digit or a wrong unit is the usual cause. When you want a clean slate, Reset restores the defaults.

1. Enter your number of coins.
2. Enter your seed (deterministic — for games/demos only).
3. Check the result — it updates instantly as you type.
4. Use Reset to start over with the default values.

## Formula

Each independent flip has a 50% probability of heads and 50% of tails.

That is the standard formula for this calculation, and it is the same one the [Coin Flip](/coin-flip) applies to the values you enter. You can work it out by hand, but the calculator is faster when you want to try several values, and it removes the risk of a slip in the arithmetic. If the figures look wrong, check your inputs first — a misplaced decimal point is the usual culprit.

## What the result shows

With the default values (Number of coins: 1, Seed (deterministic — for games/demos only): 1), the [Coin Flip](/coin-flip) returns Result: Heads, Heads: 1, Tails: 0. The first figure is the headline result, and the rest break it down so you can see how the total is made up. Change any value and every figure updates instantly. ## Tips

A few things worth knowing before you rely on the result — most of them are about the numbers you put in, rather than the tool itself:

- Check the units and labels before comparing results.
- Your entries stay in your browser and are not saved.

Keep these in mind and the figures will be as useful as the numbers you put in.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is this coin flip free?

Yes. It is free to use, with no sign-up or installation required. There is no limit on how often you use it, nothing to install, and no account to create — open the [Coin Flip](/coin-flip) and start straight away.

### Are my entries stored?

No. Calculations run in your browser and the tool does not save your entries. You can use it as often as you like, and because nothing is uploaded, stored or tracked, there is nothing to delete afterwards.

### What formula does the Coin Flip use?

Each independent flip has a 50% probability of heads and 50% of tails. You can see it in action in the [Coin Flip](/coin-flip) — enter your own values and the result updates as you type.

### What do I need to use the Coin Flip?

Just Number of coins and Seed (deterministic — for games/demos only). Enter those values and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. If you are unsure about a value, try a rough figure first and then refine it — the result updates instantly.
